snippet.title: Power Network Tycoon | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
After more than four years of development, Power Network Tycoon has finally reached version 1.0. Alongside the full release, Patch v1.0 includes a range of new features, quality-of-life improvements, balancing changes, performance improvements and bug fixes.

Power Network Tycoon is a physics-based power grid simulator, build by a power engineer.

★ Find the Game! ★
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429930/Power_Network_Tycoon/
Itch.io: https://davidmadethis.itch.io/power-network-tycoon

★ Game Details and FAQ ★
https://www.powernetworktycoon.com/

★ Socials ★
Discord: https://discord.gg/h3wxa5zY7X
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DavidMadeThis
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/PowerNetworkTycoon/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/davidmadethis.bsky.social
Mastodon: https://mastodon.social/@DavidMadeThis

★ TABLE OF CONTENTS ★
0:00 Building Your Power Network
0:36 Engineering, Costs & Community
0:56 Weather, Physics & Your Grid
